name: off-same-boundary-replacement-custom-message-references
description: official-host.ts:1940 'same-boundary replacement and custom-message references recover committed text and images'. A helper turn_end hook (before posthorse) commits, at the boundary of a 600k-char dump, context_edits replacing the seeded owner input and the dump result with text+image content, a visible custom message with text+image, and a 600k-char hidden custom message. The threshold record names the COMMITTED entry ids ('history read id ...', never draft locators or the private original); the model then reads the three entries (ids saved from get_entries while its request is held) and gets each text and image back; the record notes the omitted middle.
